reviews.text: The estimate for the new thermostat installation was fair, especially given my past experiences with other contractors, and the technician completed the job efficiently.
reviews.author: JAVONTE M.

reviews.text: Having had a challenging experience before, I was cautiously optimistic about getting my thermostat installed, and thankfully the process was straightforward and efficient. The technician clearly explained how to use the new system, which was appreciated.
reviews.author: Everett A.

reviews.text: After receiving an inflated quote from another company, this technician identified a simple issue with the capacitor and had our A/C running again within an hour. He clearly explained the problem and left everything tidy.👌🏻
reviews.author: DEIRDRE Y.
